business_problem: SRF needed a better way to support audience intelligence, recommendation, and editorial analytics for public media because digital consumption was rising fast while siloed metrics and custom KPI pipelines kept editorial teams from understanding audience behavior in time.
solution_summary: SRF uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support audience intelligence, recommendation, and editorial analytics for public media. The implementation replaced a legacy state where digital consumption was rising fast while siloed metrics and custom KPI pipelines kept editorial teams from understanding audience behavior in time. Streaming and broadcast audience events and digital app activity move through Lakeflow Jobs and Spark Declarative Pipelines and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. Genie operationalizes models, agents, and analytics that deliver content recommendations and editorial dashboards.
